emptyHint: Add your first expense. It takes a few seconds.

filters.rangeBad: The end date must be after the start date

recurring.title: Recurring transactions
recurring.subtitle: Rent, tuition, salary: set it up once and we log it every time.
recurring.emptyHint: Repeating items like rent or a music plan can be logged on the right day by themselves.
recurring.formHint: We create the transaction on each due date, once per cycle.
recurring.endBad: The end date must be after the start date
recurring.deleteBody: We won't create transactions from this one any more.
recurring.deleteKeep: Transactions it already created stay as they are.

import.title: Import transactions from CSV
import.subtitle: Review every row before anything is written. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.tooBig: That file is too large, the limit is {{mb}} MB.
import.dropHint: or choose one from your device, up to {{mb}} MB
import.locked: CSV import is part of Premium
import.lockedHint: With Premium you can bring in a bank statement or an old spreadsheet in one go, and we flag duplicates for you.
import.expired: This preview expired or was already used. Please upload the file again.
import.duplicateHint: Duplicates (same wallet, type, amount, day and note) are unticked. Tick them again if you want them imported.
import.nothingHint: Check the column headers and the date and amount formats, then try again.
import.noWallet: You need a wallet to import into
import.walletHint: Every row in the file is written to this wallet.
import.formatBody: The first row holds the column headers: date, amount, note (type and category are optional). Spending is a negative number.
import.formatNote: Cells starting with = + - @ are stored as plain text to keep them safe.
